description: Rick Tanner presents unfiltered 30-day floor data to Patricia Hawkins in direct executive review: foot traffic down 14%, test-drive conversion dropped from 31% to 22%, service lane utilization holding at 79%, inventory carrying costs disclosed. Rick commits to delivering a Millfield-specific consolidation readiness asset map within two weeks, structured around Patricia's three-tier vulnerability framework. This is the end of information filtering. Rick is positioning himself as the floor-intelligence anchor for whatever consolidation scenario Regional Auto Group executes.
